C08-M04-L07-F1.title: From an analytical question to a saved, tested query
C08-M04-L07-F1.caption: Each decision in the query specification constrains the next, and testing against known positives and negatives decides whether the query can be recorded as evidence.
C08-M04-L07-F1.alt: Flow diagram with seven steps from top to bottom. Analytical question, for example did the phish hit anyone else, in orange. Population: sources and time range, in slate. Condition: precise predicates on normalised fields, in blue. Grain: what one result row represents, in violet. Window and output: time relationships, fields, sort and limit, in blue. Test: known positives and known negatives, in green. Saved, documented query: query, specification and result in the case, in dark. A feedback arrow runs from the last step back to the first, labelled failed test or new question: refine the specification.

steps.label: Analytical question
steps.sub: e.g. did the phish hit anyone else?

steps.label: Saved, documented query
steps.sub: query + specification + result in the case

loop.label: failed test or new question: refine the specification

C08-M04-L07-F1.note: Untested 'not found' and tested 'not found' look identical in a case note; only the test tells them apart.

C08-M04-L07-F2.title: Three conditions that run cleanly and answer wrongly
C08-M04-L07-F2.caption: Imprecise and precise forms of the same three questions, with the real row counts each returns on the Banyan dataset.
C08-M04-L07-F2.alt: Two code panels. Left panel, red, titled Imprecise: a confident wrong answer. Block one: IOC search by substring, url LIKE '%cdn%', result 64 rows of which 46 are cdn.example.org. Block two: up to 07:02 on text timestamps, ts BETWEEN '...T06:00' AND '...T07:02', result 15 rows with the 07:02 events excluded. Block three: accounts never created, user NOT IN (SELECT target_user FROM events), result 0 because a NULL poisons NOT IN. Right panel, green, titled Precise: says what the question means. Block one: compare the extracted domain, domain = 'cdn-telemetry-sync.example', result 18 rows. Block two: half-open interval in full format, ts >= '...T06:00:00Z' AND ts < '...T07:03:00Z', result 17 rows. Block three: anti-join that ignores NULLs, NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM events c WHERE c.target_user = e.user), result 8 accounts.

panels.title: Precise: says what the question means

C08-M04-L07-F2.note: Each left-hand form is a precision, recall or NULL-logic failure; none of them raises an error.
